pages.text:
**Fits:** motorboats.

A cruising motorboat within 2 blocks of a [[buoys|buoy]] link follows the course on its own, even with nobody aboard, taking gentle bends at full speed and **slowing before sharp turns**.

It keeps going until the course ends, the fuel runs out or it runs aground. A rider can press back to stop. [[rose_tinted_glasses]] start and stop it on a course.

A boat left on a loop laps it until its fuel runs out.
